messages.text: What can I do to get a refund while the parcel is still on its way?

While the parcel is still on its way, we can’t refund it through this process: the order must be marked delivered, and the shop must receive the item back first (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders) (refund-policy/v2/return).

A refund must also be requested within 30 days of the recorded delivery time (refund-policy/v2/window).

Would you like a staff member to help with cancellation or delivery options? Those are outside this refund process (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders).
